notes.title: Running it back with Aerial_Knight's We Never Yield!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37851830/b7054fa78d4d2efed5dde9c364eac62a9dfe1772.jpg[/img]

Whats Good Y'all

Because of all your support I'm back with some dope news: a few minutes ago we unveiled and announced my second game [b]Aerial_Knight's We Never Yield[/b]! The game plays as its own story but it picks up exactly where its predecessor left off in 2021:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_eZ7dBtXZW8
We Never Yield offers you the well-known stylized parkour action as you run, jump, smash, and slide through various levels. And as the title suggests, you don't have to play alone this time! Take control of both characters in single-player or conquer the game with a friend in two-player local cooperative mode and experience the all-new the story of Wally & Lone and their fight against their Aunt, Queen Karmic.

This game is a big step up for me in We Never Yield: we have a dope all Black voice acting featuring Blessing Adeoye Jr., Belsheber Rusape Jr., and Black Krystel, a pulse-pounding soundtrack created by Detroit artist Danime-Sama and myself, and much more. I will tell you more about [b]Aerial_Knight's We Never Yield[/b] before its release in summer 2024.

So stay tuned and visit the Steam page from time to time. And if you like what you see don't hesitate to follow and wishlist the game - that would actually help a lot!

Again this game wouldn't be happening if it wasnt for all the support & love you've all showed by playing, wishlisting, streaming & sharing the first game. Thank you so much for letting me make this game!
Aerial_Knight


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2804740/Aerial_Knights_We_Never_Yield/

notes.title: Morrowind GOTY Edition leads Amazon Prime’s free game offerings for February
notes.notes:
February might be the shortest month, but this year it’s jam-packed with free games for anyone with an Amazon Prime membership. There’s nine games up for keepsies over the course of the month, with The Elder Scrolls III: Morrowind GOTY Edition standing out at the front of the pack from February 2nd. Members will also get to claim the bathhouse management game Onsen Master, futuristic 3D runner Aerial_Knight's Never Yield, and chibi god-brawler Divine Knockout in the first half of the month.

notes.title: SteelSeries GameSense running with Aerial_Knight's Never Yield!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37851830/55b3022855566cc32b3c11bb5d14c7d6af084435.jpg[/img]

Hey friends!

Neil Jones aka “Aerial_Knight” here! As you have probably already guessed, I am the developer of [b]Aerial_Knight’s Never Yield[/b]. And in case you didn't know: [b]The release is already tomorrow![/b]

It is my first game and a very stylized experience. And that is why I was very interested when SteelSeries offered me the possibility to extend the style beyond the screen with GameSense. What is GameSense? It is their program that illuminates their keyboards, mouses and headsets with LEDs. You all know this fancy high-class RGB illuminated peripherals? That is exactly what we are talking about here.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37851830/eb68efce88a8247e93d88b5fcd454103a98e7cd9.png[/img]

Never Yield's game design gave me a very cool way to integrate GameSense into the game in a useful way. It's a great thing when the keyboard lights up a little colorful, but when it supports the gameplay, it's a whole other level. And if you've played the demo, you know that the movements in Never Yield are based on a color code. High objects and obstacles for example can be overcome only with a high jump, and those objects have a red outline. The game tells you which key to press via the colored outline.

And that’s a perfect fit for RGB illuminated gaming peripherals! Taking a look on the keyboard, both WASD and the arrow keys are illuminated in the four movement colors Red, Blue, Yellow and Purple. That’s the basic support the keyboard offers. The rest of the RGB Illumination depends on what difficulty level you play Never Yield on. On the easy and medium difficulty levels, the entire keyboard flashes before the obstacle appears in the corresponding color of the key that needs to be pressed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37851830/f2f6999fca3c584b87aa558b3972427432527ee2.png[/img]

On easy this happens some distance before the obstacle, on medium just before it. On the third and hardest difficulty level, WASD and the arrow keys are still illuminated, but the entire keyboard does not light up anymore. Why not? Because for those players who play on the highest difficulty level, Never Yield should be a challenge! And I don't want to ruin that experienced for you of course. 😉

What was very important to me in implementing GameSense is that Never Yield doesn't lose its challenge and appeal. It definitely doesn't lose its appeal, because the illumination underlines the style of the game brilliantly well! And what about the challenge? The RGB illumination doesn't give you any advantage that you wouldn't have without GameSense. Never Yield also sneaks you the color of the next obstacle in your way ingame - you should keep an eye on the upper right corner of your monitor.

And whether you play with GameSense included or not, always remember: Never Yield!

Till tomorrow and take care everyone!
Neil 'Aerial_Knight' Jones


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1323540/Aerial_Knights_Never_Yield/

notes.title: Soundtrack launch this Summer; first single available NOW!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37851830/c27235e29ba145bb00405df03b2923cc0de5a233.jpg[/img]

Hey friends!

Good news for all you runners out there: I and Daniel Wilkins have teamed up with [b]Black Screen Records[/b] to the release the soundtrack of [b]Aerial_Knight's Never Yield[/b] this summer! To deliver you all the tunes of my game featuring the authentic sounds of Detroit artists and vocals from artists of colour from all over the world!

The first single "The Man Who Outran Time" (you might now it from the announcement trailer in August last year) is now available [url=https://ffm.to/themanwhooutrantime][b]on all streaming platforms[/b][/url]!

[url=https://ffm.to/themanwhooutrantime][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37851830/8c349d8e0e45a1c0d524573db2e790faf5e69e92.jpg[/img][/url]

[b]Neil 'Aerial_Knight' Jones:[/b]
[i]"We spent a lot of time crafting this song to be something that would not only be perfect and custom made for the level but also something we people would love to listen to in their car on a road trip. We based the whole soundtrack off of that ideal."[/i]

Daniel Wilkins:
[i]"We spent a lot of hours going over songs searching for the right sound. We wanted something that not only sounded different but something that you could listen to repeatedly with a good balance of old and new."[/i]

Have a good time listening to "The Man Who Outran Time"!
Neil 'Aerial_Knight' Jones
